stem: How did President Harry S. Truman’s decision to drop the atomic bomb affect international relations?

options.label: A
options.text: It initiated the arms race with the Soviet Union.

options.label: B
options.text: It prompted other nations to begin investigations of war crimes.

options.label: C
options.text: It enabled the United Nations to administer territory in Japan.

options.label: D
options.text: It led to the establishment of the first global peacekeeping force.
